title: test(showcase-e2e): aim the fieldGroup header-icon locator at the disclosure button the pinned console renders
body:
Fixes #24288
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

One locator in `examples/app-showcase/e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts`, in the test "grouped: fieldGroup sections render and Money starts collapsed". Nothing else changes. Every other assertion stays as it was, including `getByText('banknote', { exact: true })` at count 0, the "not literal icon-name text" half.

- Before: `page.locator('div:has(> span:text-is("Money")) svg').first()`
- After: `page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Money' }).locator('*:has(> span:text-is("Money")) svg').first()`

## Which of the card's two readings holds: reading 2 (a stale locator), measured in a browser

I built the showcase closure and the vendored console at the current pin `5e15928b4631` the way the workflow does: `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/example-showcase^...`, then `bash scripts/build-console.sh`, then `pnpm check:console-sha` ("Console dist matches the objectui pin (objectui@5e15928b4631)"). Then I ran the spec in Chromium against my own `serve --dev` backend.

- **Red reproduced** with the unmodified spec at `d537a318b`: 1 failed, 2 passed. The failure is at `:117`, "Money header icon svg … element(s) not found", the same assertion as CI runs `39013050476` and `39107125964`.
- **The icon still renders.** The failure screenshot shows the banknote glyph beside "Money". Here is the header's `outerHTML` from the running console, with the svg path data trimmed:

```text
div.CardHeader(relative … cursor-pointer)
  div(text-base font-semibold tracking-tight)            ← CardTitle
    button[type=button][aria-expanded=false][data-state=closed]
      span.flex.items-center.gap-2
        svg.lucide.lucide-banknote.h-4.w-4[aria-hidden=true]   ← the fieldGroups[].icon
        span "Money"
      span.flex.items-center.gap-2
        svg.lucide.lucide-chevron-right[aria-hidden=true]      ← the disclosure chevron
```

- **Why the old locator misses.** The element that directly holds the title span is now a `span`, not a `div`. objectui `4be76e0306` (objectui#12625, PR objectui#12661) made the collapsible header a native disclosure button. Before that change it was `CardTitle > div.flex.items-center.gap-2 > SectionIcon + span`, with the chevron in a sibling `div`.
- **Counts on the live page:**

| Locator | Count |
|:---|:---|
| old locator | 0 |
| `getByRole('button', { name: 'Money' })` | 1 |
| svgs anywhere in that button | 2 |
| svgs under the element that holds the title span | 1 |
| literal `banknote` text | 0 |

Ancestry, measured on a full-history (not shallow) objectui clone with control legs:

| Check | Exit |
|:---|:---|
| `4be76e0306` is an ancestor of the pin `5e15928b4631` | 0 |
| `4be76e0306` is an ancestor of `daeb77fc84dd`, the pin of the last green run `38866628889` | 1 |
| Control: `daeb77fc84dd~50` in `daeb77fc84dd` | 0 |
| Control: `daeb77fc84dd~200` in `daeb77fc84dd` | 0 |

The pins were read from `.objectui-sha` at each run's `head_sha`:

| Run | Pin | Result |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `38866628889` | `daeb77fc84dd` | green |
| `39013050476` | `5e15928b4631` | red |
| `39107125964` | `5e15928b4631` | red |

So the green-to-red window is `daeb77fc84dd` → `5e15928b4631`, and the header rewrite is inside it.

## Why the locator is scoped this way

The disclosure button holds TWO svgs: the section icon and the chevron. A plain `getByRole('button', { name: 'Money' }).locator('svg')` would match the chevron, and the test would stay green with no icon at all. The ablation below measures exactly that. So the new locator does two things:

- It anchors on the button named by the section title. That is the header's shape since objectui#12625.
- It then looks for the svg under whatever element **directly holds the title span**. That keeps the old locator's precision: the icon sits beside the title, and the chevron sits in a sibling. It is also tag-agnostic, so a later `span`↔`div` swap of that wrapper does not make it stale again.

## Proof the new locator can fail (throwaway, nothing kept)

The fix was committed first (`eff17f783`). Then `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` removed the Money fieldGroup's `icon: 'banknote',` line from `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/semantic-zoo.object.ts`. The tool reported "anchor 1 -> 0, blob 938574b217f8 -> d5103f0d9319". With the line removed, a fresh backend ran the spec:

- **Mutated leg: red.** 1 failed, 2 passed. The failure is the new locator at `:125`, "element(s) not found". The live header still had its button and chevron, but no icon svg:

| Count | Mutated leg |
|:---|:---|
| svgs anywhere in the button | 1 (the chevron, so a bare button-svg locator would have stayed GREEN) |
| svgs under the element that holds the title span | 0 |

- **Restore.** The tool restored the file and proved it: "blob == HEAD (938574b217f8) and `git diff HEAD` is empty".
- **Restored leg: green** on a fresh backend at `eff17f783`, 3 passed.

## Verification (final head `eff17f783`, console pin `5e15928b4631`)

| Check | Result |
|:---|:---|
| `playwright test e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts` | 3 passed |
| Full `playwright test` (all of `test:smoke`), one run | **53 passed (2.5m)**. On CI this was 52 of 53. |
| `tsc --noEmit --listFiles` (the package's `typecheck`) | exit 0; the spec is in the program (1 hit) |
| `vitest run --maxWorkers=2` (the package's `test`; it excludes `e2e/**`) | 36 files, 431 tests passed |

Local runs used Chromium at `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium` (via `OS_TEST_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH`) and a backend on a random port (via `SMOKE_API_URL`). Two declared differences from the workflow:

- `CI` was unset, so `retries` was 0 rather than 1.
- objectui's dependency build ran with turbo `--concurrency=2`, and the objectui source came from a scratch clone (`OBJECTUI_ROOT`) at the same pin.

**This PR shows no `Showcase Smoke` check-run.** `.github/workflows/showcase-smoke.yml` triggers only on `workflow_dispatch` and the 07:00Z schedule, and no PR workflow runs `examples/app-showcase/e2e`. The fleet relay's `workflow_dispatch` allowlist is `shard-timings-refresh.yml` and `release.yml`. The local runs above are the evidence. The card's last "Done when" bullet, `Showcase Smoke` green on `main`, can only be read from the first nightly run after this lands.

## Changeset

None. `@objectstack/example-showcase` is `private: true` and publishes nothing, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.

## Acceptance notes

- `#24283` (the pin move) is not touched here. The header shape measured above is on objectui `main` as triage read it, so the re-aimed locator should hold at that pin too. Whichever PR lands second merges `main` and re-runs this spec against the pin it then carries (the claim's serial note).
- The assertion stays svg-generic, as before. It proves a real icon renders, not which glyph. `SectionIcon` falls back to Lucide's `Database` svg for a name Lucide does not know, and that would also satisfy it. Narrowing it to the declared glyph is outside this card.
